firstLogin.welcomeModalHeader: Welcome to your new Impact Account
firstLogin.welcomeModalInfo1: Add money to your account now and over time. Then, give to your favourite charities from your account whenever you like.
firstLogin.welcomeModalInfo2: Select the Impact Account card to get started.
firstLogin.welcomeModalInfo3: Then, give to your favourite charities from your account whenever you like.

getStarted.allTaskDoneText: Nice work! By taking these first steps, you’re already making a big impact.
getStarted.checkListText: We’ve created a handy checklist to help you get started on your giving journey.
getStarted.addMoneyDesc: Take this first step so you have charitable dollars available to give to charities from your account.
getStarted.giveCharityDesc: Support a charity of your choice with the dollars in your account. Or, support a Giving Group, which is a group of people giving together.
getStarted.giveFriendDesc: Send charitable dollars from your account to a friend so they can support the charities of their choice.

accountBalance.helpModalHeader: How does adding money and giving to charity work?
accountBalance.helpModalDesc: Your Impact Account helps you act on your generosity. It also helps you take time and space to plan the impact you want to make.
accountBalance.helpModalAddMoneyDesc: The more you add, the more you’ll have available to support charities when you want to give. You’ll get a tax receipt whenever you add money.
accountBalance.helpModalCharityTitle: Give to your favourite charities from your account
accountBalance.helpModalCharityDesc: Or, discover new charities that match your interests. You can give to any registered charity in Canada.
accountBalance.helpModalFriendsDesc: Find friends and family on Charitable Impact. Then, send them charitable dollars that they can use to support their favourite charities.
accountBalance.giveToCharityText: Give to a charity or Giving Group
accountBalance.giveToFriendtext: Send friends charitable dollars to give away

discoverForYou.noDataHeader: Select causes and topics to see charities and Giving Groups that might interest you.

oneBillionSubHeaderText1: It's because of donors like you that we've reached
oneBillionText3: Thank you for using Charitable Impact to give.
noTaxReceipts: No tax receipts to show here yet.
